difficulty_reason: Beyond the supplied exact-transform mechanism, the authors extend a fixed-window Lévy first-passage increment estimate to all sublinear windows and derive uniform weighted-measure increments, with both full local proofs retained. They then match these estimates to a moving saddle interval of center sqrt(t) and width t^(1/4), using regular variation and Potter bounds to obtain a uniform integrable majorant on a growing main region. A separate far-tail estimate is needed to justify the exchange of asymptotic limit and integral and identify the exact stretched-exponential prefactor. These quantified uniform-window and moving-saddle proof obligations exceed ordinary qualification probability, and are distinct from Theorem1.2 PDE construction; the previous transform support remains uncounted.
